Long Answer Type Questions
Questions No. 9 and 10 are Long Answer Type questions. Answer any one of the following. (6x1=6)
9. Draw a labelled diagram of an electric motor. Explain its principle and working. What is the function of split ring in an electric motor?    (6)
10. What is electric power? Derive H = I²Rt, where H is the amount of heat produced by steady current I through a resistor R in time t.    (6)

notes: Question 6's Hindi says 'Lenz ke dahine haath ka niyam' (Lenz's right-hand rule) while the English says "State Fleming's left-hand rule" — the printed Hindi and English disagree on whose rule it is (Fleming vs Lenz) and which hand. Transcribed exactly as printed on each side, not reconciled — a genuine printed-paper inconsistency, not a transcription error.
